technology.summary: Today's most important technology news includes a new California law that will fine robotaxi operators for blocking first responders, Amazon's call for support for AI data center projects, and Meta's plan to give away Muse code for free to encourage its use in everyday gadgets. TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is also underway, with a focus on building enduring companies in the AI era. Additionally, Home Assistant is rebranding its cloud service to Link, citing big tech's negative impact on the cloud.

finance.summary: Today's most important finance news includes a decline in Indian equity benchmarks due to profit booking and rising oil prices, with the Nifty 50 index closing down by 95.75 points. Benchmark indices also faced a decline as global uncertainty impacted the market and investor sentiment remained cautious. The Securities and Exchange Board of India and the Reserve Bank of India have teamed up to make it easier for foreign portfolio investors to enter the market. A resurgent El Niño pattern risks deepening a selloff in Southeast Asian bonds, threatening to push yields higher as rising US Treasury rates and oil prices squeeze regional debt.

A seven-year-old student died at Balrampur school while a procession carrying loudspeakers and a music system was passing nearby.

The BJD has launched its annual month-long public outreach programme on the occasion of Mahatma Gandhi's birth anniversary.

TVK ministers have criticised DMK chief Stalin for allegedly body-shaming Dharapuram bypoll candidate Sathyabama.
